name: Charlie
summary: Neutered, fully vaccinated and healthy. A special boy who loves to play and nap.
story:
We rescued Charlie in Zarqa, sitting in a mud puddle. He was very thin and very weak.

At first his liver readings were high, so he was on Royal Canin Hepatic food for a while, with fluids, check-ups and tests. Little by little he got better, and today his readings are back to normal and he is healthy.

Charlie is a very special boy. He loves to play and to sleep, and he is a little chubby, but in good health. His story started out sad, but thankfully everything is fine now.
